messages:
priya: ok i'm up for the 9-5 UTC shift. quick recap before i take over — we had a paging storm last night tied to relay autoscaling + a kv-cache eviction loop. primary was jamal, secondary maria handled escalation. incident is closed but followups exist.
jamal: thanks — leaving notes below. paging started ~02:12 UTC when load spiked from a bad client load test hitting long-context routes. autoscaler overshot, pods restarted, kv cache warmed repeatedly and caused 5xx spikes.
maria: main customer impact was autocomplete latency for EU customers — SLO breaches for ~12 min. we throttled the client group and rerouted traffic to a smaller model variant to mitigate.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT #INC-2026-122 created at 2026-03-14T02:14:22Z — severity: sev2 — assigned: jamal — pageresolved: 02:26 UTC.
sre-bot: post-incident checklist: notify cs for affected tenants, open followup tickets, schedule retros.
priya: ok action items i need from the handoff: 1) link to root cause analysis, 2) which runbooks used, 3) immediate mitigations still live, 4) owners for followups.
jamal: RCA draft: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-122 (private). Runbooks used: KV cache thrash runbook (https://runbooks.redwood.internal/kv-cache-thrash) and Autoscaler emergency scale-down steps. Mitigations still live: temporary client-group throttle and model-variant fallback (routing rule r-evict-2026).
maria: i created the followup ticket FEAT-4242 to add autoscaler upper bound safeguards + better client tagging. assigned to alex.
alex: i have FEAT-4242 in my queue. plan: add per-client burst limiter + circuit breaker for long-sequence endpoints. ETA: PR by Friday.
kai: tagged infra to add a predeploy test that simulates long-context client to catch autoscaler oscillation. ops-bot: created task OPS-98 to add that job to CI.
priya: are there any coverage gaps for my shift? specifically nights in APAC or EU where we're light on secondary coverage?
jamal: gap: 00:00-06:00 UTC we often only have one oncall for infra. yesterday maria (EU) was good but we should avoid relying on a single person for escalation. request: add a floating secondary for 00-06 UTC (volunteer).
maria: i can cover 23:30-03:30 UTC next two nights. priya can you coordinate with rotations to get a volunteer for 03:30-06:00?
priya: noted. i'll ping rotations channel and see if someone can swap. also listing runbook pointers here: KV cache thrash runbook -> follow the quick throttle, warmup, and manual pin steps. Autoscaler emergency steps -> scale-down, disable autoscale, apply fixed replica count 6.
jamal: small ops tip — when applying fixed replica count, set env SKIP_PROBE=true so probes don't kill pods while cache warms. documented in runbook.
priya: post-handoff followups i will own: 1) confirm alex PR merges (FEAT-4242), 2) ensure OPS-98 test exists and runs in staging, 3) coordinate retrospective.
priya: i've scheduled a 45m retro for Wed 2026-03-17 09:30 UTC, calendar invite sent to eng-oncall, infra, and platform. agenda: timeline, root cause, automation to prevent recurrence, comms with customers.
jamal: filed a customer-impact ticket CS-3307 and added release notes for the affected customers. cs will send an update by EOD.
maria: small followup — can we get better metrics on model-variant fallback rates? i saw 20% fallback during the incident and want a dashboard tile. alex adding as FEAT-4243.
priya: thanks. final quick handoff checklist: primary = priya for next 8h, secondary = jamal for first 4h then maria will be backup after 13:30 UTC, oncall-bot configured to page both on sev2, escalation policy set to 15m -> 5m -> pager until ack.
oncall-bot: Reminder: shift change at 09:00 UTC — please acknowledge within 5 minutes.
priya: acked. leaving the channel for next shift watchers: if anything pops, page me and jamal; i'll be reachable on phone as fallback.
jamal: leaving notes in the incident doc and will merge timeline edits. thanks team. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Created followups: FEAT-4242, FEAT-4243, OPS-98, CS-3307. Links in incident doc.
priya: closing handoff thread. i'll add these action items to the monday squad sync. good luck everyone.
